people.imagined: A river landing at night with a hemp bundle at his feet. He holds up his thumb to a stranger who asked about the river, showing the nail-shaped scar, and grins. He cuts the toll chain when it suits him.
people.subject: The moment: crouched on a wet river landing at night, he holds up his right thumb toward the viewer and grins, a bale of hemp at his feet. Face: most important, the thumb: a raised pale scar across the ball of the right thumb in the exact shape of a long iron nail, with a round head and a pointed tip, held up large in the frame. A lean, wiry, river-weathered face; a hard jaw with three days of stubble; narrow, bright, honest brown eyes under straight dark brows; a nose bent slightly left; a lopsided grin showing one chipped tooth. Hair: black, wet and slicked back, tied in a short tail with a strip of dark blue silk cord and a small silver clasp. Body: thin and strong, narrow sinewy shoulders, knees apart in a crouch. Clothing: the plain graceful robes of a low-realm river cultivator: a layered robe of deep river-blue gauze over a grey silk under-robe, two crossed collars open at the neck, wide sleeves tied back above the elbow with cord and the hem knotted up, wet at the shoulders; a sash of woven silver-grey silk holding a short chain-cutter and a pair of iron shears; a plain jade bead at the sash; bare feet. Hands and objects: the scarred thumb raised; in the other hand a short length of rusted iron chain with one cut link; at his feet a tight bale of pale hemp tied with three cords. Power: a few pale blue motes of water qi drift off his wet sleeves, very faint. Background: a black river under mist, a far lantern glow, reeds, a dark moored boat. Light: pale blue moonlight from the upper left with a soft silver rim on his hair, a thin warm gleam of lantern on the chain. Expression: a hard, bright, daring look held on the viewer, the grin crooked and the eyes narrowed as if waiting for the question.

people.imagined: Her rope-walk at midday. She is making a knot instead of signing her name, and has not tested one since she wove the bridge a carter's boy fell through. She works with eyes half closed, forgiving everything.
people.subject: The moment: seated in a long rope-walk, she ties a knot in a thick rope with practised hands and looks up under her brows with an easy half-smile. Face: most important, the fingertips: two fingertips of the right hand, forefinger and middle, worn perfectly smooth and shiny as river pebbles with no fingerprint ridges, held up as she pulls the knot tight. A round, soft, lined, brown face about fifty; heavy-lidded, kind, dark eyes; faint thin brows; a wide nose; a loose, slow smile; a few grey hairs at the chin. Hair: grey-black, in a loose knot at the nape held by a plain jade pin, wisps of hemp fibre caught in it. Body: broad and strong, thick wrists and forearms corded like her ropes; she sits slouched and relaxed. Clothing: the simple graceful silk of a low-realm craftswoman: a soft moss-green layered robe with two crossed collars, wide sleeves rolled above the elbow and bound with braided green cord, a long under-skirt of pale grey gauze, a broad sash of braided green rope, a small spool of twine and a little jade ring at the sash; plain cloth shoes. Hands and objects: the thick coarse rope across her lap; a dozen short ropes in different knots hang on a peg beside her, each a distinct shape. Power: a few faint green wood-qi motes drift among the hanging ropes. Background: a long shed with strands of rope stretched into the misty distance and soft bright light at the far end. Light: warm hazy spirit-light from the left, tiny floating fibres glowing gold like motes, a soft rim on her cheek. Expression: a slow, easy, half-lidded smile, loose shoulders and a warm unhurried gaze that forgives before she is asked.

people.imagined: The deck of the free ferry, morning. He combs his eleven-hair beard with his fingers as he tells a captain something sly about his master. His nose peels from the sun.
people.subject: The moment: leaning on the rail of a ferry at misty morning, he combs his chin with the fingers of one hand as if the beard were full, and talks sideways to someone beside the viewer. Face: most important, the thin beard: an obviously sparse beard of only eleven long dark hairs on the chin and jaw, each one separate, and a nose that is red and peeling in flakes. A long, boyish, sunburnt face about twenty; bright, quick, brown eyes; arched brows; a wide mouth in a sly smile; fine freckles across the sunburnt cheeks. Hair: dark brown, cut short and uneven and sticking up, a strip of faded red silk tied round the brow. Body: tall, narrow-shouldered, gangly, elbows on the rail, one foot hooked behind the other. Clothing: the plain graceful silk of a young low-realm drifter: a sleeveless grey silk over-vest with a crossed collar worn over a pale blue gauze under-robe with wide loose sleeves that flap in the wind; a cord sash with a small knife and a pale blue jade pendant; a string of blue glass beads at the neck; bare feet. Hands and objects: the combing hand; in the other a coil of mooring rope looped over his wrist. Power: a few faint blue water-qi motes glitter above the river beside him. Background: a wide brown river under pearl mist, a flat ferry deck with crates, a heron on the far bank, another boat far off. Light: soft golden morning spirit-light from the upper left, river glitter and a pale rim light on his hair. Expression: a sly, cheerful, gregarious grin, sure the captain will believe his gossip.

people.imagined: A net-mender's bench at Tân Khẩu at dusk. The groove in her thumb could take a reed. She breaks the village's silence by walking bread to the Watch each season, and thinks of her son.
people.subject: The moment: seated on a low bench at evening with a net across her lap, she looks quietly at the viewer, her thumb pressing the twine. Face: most important, the thumb: the left thumb has a deep, clean, shiny groove worn across the pad and down the side, a reed's width, plainly visible as she holds it out to hold the twine. A lined, round, brown face of about sixty-two with heavy cheeks; patient, tired, dark eyes; thick grey brows; a flat nose; a closed mouth, down at the corners with grief; a few age spots at the temples and heavy eyelids. Hair: grey and thin, twisted into a small bun under a faded blue silk headcloth with a single silver pin. Body: stout, bent forward, shoulders rounded from years at the net; a soft grey shawl over her knees. Clothing: the simple graceful silk of an old low-realm net-mender: a dark blue layered robe with two crossed collars, mended neatly at the elbows, wide sleeves, a long pale grey under-skirt, a plain sash of faded blue silk; a small loaf wrapped in cloth tied at her belt with a smooth jade bead. Hands and objects: a half-mended net of dark twine, a wooden netting needle in the right hand, a ball of twine at her feet; the grooved thumb pressed on the knot. Power: a very faint earth-brown glow in the twine, nothing more. Background: a low fisher's cottage wall, hanging nets, a pale misty evening sky. Light: low amber dusk spirit-light from the upper left, deep blue shadow behind, a thin silver rim on her grey hair. Expression: a patient, grieving gentleness, a stubborn woman who will walk the bread to the Watch again.

people.imagined: The edge of the grey miasma, early. Her hands are grey-green to the wrists from the moss; a white band on her arm marks where a bracelet sat, and she will not say whose.
people.subject: The moment: kneeling at the edge of a grey mist bank, she lifts a handful of pale grey moss and looks at the viewer with careful, level eyes. Face: most important, the stained hands: both hands and forearms grey-green to the wrist as if dipped in dye, with a sharp pale band on the left forearm, a bracelet's width, where the skin is untouched. A thin, smooth, olive-pale face of about thirty; careful, dark-grey eyes; straight thin brows; a small straight nose; a lazy, closed mouth; a smear of grey moss on one cheek. Hair: black, in a loose braid tied with a strip of green-grey silk. Body: slight, kneeling on one knee, shoulders relaxed. Clothing: the simple graceful silk of a low-realm herb-gatherer: a hooded cloak of soft grey-brown gauze thrown back from her shoulders over a pale olive layered robe with two crossed collars and wide sleeves rolled to the elbow, a narrow sash of green-grey silk with a small knife and cloth bags, a little jade clasp; soft wrapped cloth shoes stained grey. Hands and objects: a thick fistful of silvery-grey moss dripping with damp; a woven basket beside her, half filled with grey moss. Power: a faint earth-yellow glow gathers in her stained palms and the mist is tinged faintly olive. Background: a wall of low, still, grey-white mist, a few dead black twigs. Light: pale grey spirit-light from the upper left, soft and shadowless, a faint rim light on the edge of her hood. Expression: level dark-grey eyes that watch without blinking, the mouth lazy and closed, her face giving nothing away.

people.imagined: A burned ruin in spring, peach blossom on the black stumps. The market children cross the road to avoid his lopsided face; he walks with a dragging right foot, digging where ghost lights shone.
people.subject: The moment: standing among blackened ruin walls with peach blossom behind him, he looks directly at the viewer with a tired, open face, a short spade on his shoulder. Face: most important, the lopsided face: the right side of the face sagging and pulled lower than the left, the right eye drooping, the right corner of the mouth dragged down and the right cheek flat, while the left side is normal and kind. A broad, ash-pale face of about forty-two with a heavy jaw; deep-set brown eyes; thick brows, the right one lower; a wide nose; a loose right lip. Ash dusts his lashes. Hair: black and grey, thick, powdered with grey ash at the crown, tied up in a plain knot with a dark wooden pin. Body: tall and big-boned, leaning on the left leg, the right foot turned slightly in. Clothing: the plain graceful silk of a low-realm ruin-digger, kept clean though ash-grey: a long dark brown layered robe with two crossed collars and wide sleeves tied back for work, mended at the shoulders, over a pale grey under-robe; a broad sash of faded brown silk hung with small iron picks and a dull jade charm; wrapped cloth boots. Hands and objects: a short iron spade over his shoulder; in the left hand a blackened ring, charred and bent, held up to the light. Power: a thin pale ghost glow lingers low in the shadows of the ruin, and a faint green wood-qi shimmer on the blossom. Background: burnt stumps of walls and a single peach tree in bloom, charred beams crossing a pale mist sky like ribs, pink petals lying in the grey ash. Light: soft white spirit-light from the upper left, pink petals drifting, a gentle silver rim on his hair. Expression: a gentle, open, tired resignation to the stares, the good side of the mouth lifted.

people.imagined: The Night Rain Market, wet lanterns. A cup drops somewhere and he startles; his hands pat the pockets of a coat he does not own, a runner with other people's parcels.
people.subject: The moment: in a rainy lantern-lit market lane, he flinches at a sound just off frame, one hand patting at his coat pocket. Face: most important, the startle and the borrowed coat: his shoulders jump to his ears, eyes wide, and the coat he wears is far too big, its sleeves covering his knuckles, as he pats the pockets on it. A young, round, wet face of about twenty-one with big, worried, dark eyes; short thick brows lifted; a snub nose; a half-open mouth. Hair: black, plastered to his forehead by rain, a stray tuft sticking up, a thin silver band across the brow. Body: slim, shoulders high, leaning back on one heel. Clothing: the plain graceful silk of a low-realm market lad wearing a borrowed outer robe: an oversized deep green oiled-silk over-robe with wide sleeves, rolled twice and still too long, hanging to his knees and dripping, over a pale grey silk under-robe with two crossed collars; a plain sash with a small jade bead; wet cloth shoes. Hands and objects: one hand patting the pocket, the other clutching a small bundle wrapped in oiled paper tied with string, with no writing. Power: a few faint green wood-qi motes shine in the falling rain around him. Background: a narrow wet lane lined with hanging paper lanterns glowing red and yellow in mist, dark stalls, falling rain. Light: coloured lantern glow from both sides, red on his left cheek and gold on his right, rain streaks bright, a soft rim light on his wet hair. Expression: wide dark eyes darting off frame, brows lifted high, a sheepish half-smile fighting with worry on his wet face.

people.imagined: A toad wood at dusk. She keeps a tree at her left side so that nobody can stand there, and her wrists are green. A toad is cupped in her hand and she smiles, unkind.
people.subject: The moment: standing in a dim wood with her left side against a thick tree trunk, she cups a fat toad in her right hand and smiles coldly. Face: most important, the green wrists and the toad: both wrists tinted a faint sickly green like old bronze, and the toad in her palm, a warty brown-green toad with a glistening throat and orange eyes. A narrow, sharp, pale face of about twenty-four; thin black brows; narrow, cold, light-green eyes; a pointed nose; thin lips in a small, cruel smile. Hair: black, in a tight single braid wound round her head, held by a bone pin and a small green jade hairpiece. Body: thin and angular, standing with her left shoulder pressed to the tree, her body turned. Clothing: the graceful silk of a low-realm poison-maker, narrow and severe: a dark green layered robe with two crossed high collars buttoned close, narrow sleeves fastened at the wrist, a pale grey gauze over-robe trailing behind her, edged with embroidery of vines and small toads in dull silver thread; a dark sash with a row of small stoppered clay vials; waxed gloves tucked in the sash; dark boots to the knee. Hands and objects: the toad; a small flat horn spoon in the other hand; a wicker cage of toads at her feet. Power: a faint green and purple haze of poison and wood qi curls off her sleeves into the mist. Background: a dark swamp wood, bent trunks, trailing moss, pale mist. Light: dim greenish moonlight from the upper left, a thin gleam on the toad's wet back and a cold rim on her cheek. Expression: a thin, small, cold smile, the pale green eyes narrowed and unwarmed, her chin tilted as if she looks down from far off.

people.imagined: An inn doorway. He has stood up again before the lesson ended and drifts toward the door; a fine sword rides in a battered scabbard on his hip. The scorch on his collar came, he says, from a duel.
people.subject: The moment: leaning in a doorway with his weight tipped toward the exit, he looks lazily at the viewer, a hand resting on a sword hilt. Face: most important, the sword in its bad sheath: a plain beautiful straight sword with a clean steel guard and a perfect grip, slung in a cracked, scuffed, mismatched leather sheath held with string, large in the frame, and a brown scorch mark on his collar. A handsome, arrogant, tanned face of about thirty-five with a strong jaw; half-lidded dark-grey eyes with a lazy challenge in them; arched brows; a straight nose; a faint smirk; a short beard; a sun-coloured scar across the left cheekbone. Hair: black, tied in a loose knot with a pale silk lace and a silver pin. Body: tall, lean, long-legged, slouched against the frame. Clothing: the graceful silk of a low-realm wandering swordsman: a dark grey layered robe with two crossed collars, the right collar singed brown, wide sleeves flowing, a short travelling cloak of dark gauze over one shoulder, a faded red silk sash, a small jade pendant; dark boots. Hands and objects: the right hand on the hilt; the left holding a bone toothpick; a little polished brightness along the sword's quillon, the one cared-for thing on him. Power: a faint grey-gold sheen of metal qi on the clean blade edge. Background: an inn's dim hall with a table, a bright misty slice of road beyond the door. Light: pale silvery light from the doorway at his right, dim from the upper left, a soft rim light on his jaw. Expression: an arrogant, restless, lazily bold half-smirk, a man already half out the door.

people.imagined: A ridge tavern at noon. His breath is wine at any hour, the dogs keep away from his thick red neck, and he is weeping a little at a table where he once sold his niece's hair.
people.subject: The moment: slumped at a tavern table with a wine bowl in his fist, he looks up at the viewer with red wet eyes. Face: most important, the red neck and the wine: a thick, flushed, brick-red neck swelling above his collar, and a large wine bowl brimming in his hand. A heavy, puffy, red-brown face of about fifty; small watery eyes red at the rims; thick, tufty brows; a bulbous veined nose; loose wet lips; patchy grey stubble. Hair: thin, grey-brown, greasy, combed across the crown, a faded cap on the table. Body: thick, stooped, big belly, slumped forward on his elbows. Clothing: the faded finery of a low-realm hunter gone to seed, plainer by his story: a once-fine brown silk layered robe with two crossed collars, stained at the front with food, wide sleeves worn at the cuffs, a collar edged in fur worn to bare thread, a dull gold-brown sash with an empty knife sheath. Hands and objects: a wine bowl chipped at the rim in his right hand; a lock of black hair tied with red thread lies on the table by his left hand. Power: a faint grey-gold haze of metal qi hangs sad and thin over the bowl. Background: a dim tavern, a dog slinking under another table, a smoky window, soft lamp-glow. Light: dull amber light from the window at the upper left, deep brown shadow, a faint warm rim on his wet lip. Expression: red, wet, drink-heavy eyes, a slack, quivering mouth and a hangdog, maudlin droop.

people.imagined: The bandit camp's gate at the Thạch Môn ridge. He charges the caravans whatever his temper says. On his left wrist the road-book brand has been scratched through with a nail.
people.subject: The moment: standing at a log gate with his arms crossed, he lifts his left wrist a little to show the brand while he squints at an approaching caravan beyond the viewer. Face: most important, the wrist brand: a square branded mark on the inside of the left wrist, scratched through with raw jagged crossing lines, still red and pink, large in the frame. A narrow, brown, weathered face of about forty with a long jaw; sharp, dark, restless eyes; thick brows; a long nose with a notch; a twisted half-smile; a few days' stubble. Hair: black, to the shoulders, with a red silk band tied round the forehead. Body: wiry, tall, one shoulder dropped, a guide's long legs. Clothing: the graceful silk of a low-realm caravan guide: a dark green layered robe with two crossed collars and the sleeves cut short at the forearm, a long grey gauze over-robe falling to the knee, a woven straw cape thrown back from one shoulder, a broad dark sash with brass studs and a curved knife, a small bronze charm; wrapped boots. Hands and objects: a bamboo staff notched with cuts leaning on his shoulder; the scratched wrist held forward. Power: a faint green wood-qi glimmer curls up the staff. Background: a log palisade gate with spikes, a rocky ridge in mist, a dusty road with a line of wagons far below. Light: hard pale morning light from the upper left, black shadows under the brow, a silver rim light along his jaw. Expression: a brazen, squinting stare with the chin thrust out and a half-sneer, sure of his own temper and bound to nothing.

people.imagined: A dry afternoon at the camp's water trough. His hair stands on end in the dry air from the thread of Thunder in him; he will not touch a pick but hauls water, jaw set, still grey in the hands.
people.subject: The moment: carrying two full wooden pails on a yoke across his shoulders in a dusty camp yard, he looks at the viewer with a stubborn scowl. Face: most important, the standing hair: his short black hair standing straight up in every direction like the quills of a startled animal, with a few single hairs reaching out, and the grey of the mine in every crease of the hands. A broad, strong, grim face of about twenty-eight with a square jaw; angry dark eyes under thick straight brows; a flat nose; tight lips; a faint pale scar on the brow. Dust has caked on his sweat in grey stripes. Hair: black and coarse, cropped close at the neck, a dusting of grey at the temple. Body: thick, strongly built, heavy through the shoulders and arms; his neck is bent by the yoke, which has pressed a red groove into each shoulder. Clothing: the plain graceful silk of a low-realm labourer, kept clean: a sleeveless brown silk over-robe with a crossed collar over a pale grey under-robe whose wide sleeves are knotted back; a dark sash with a plain jade ring; trousers wrapped at the shin; sturdy cloth boots. Hands and objects: both hands gripping the yoke; the pails brim with water, one slopping a bright curve of drops; his hands are grey in every crease. Power: a faint violet-white thunder-qi spark crawls on one wet bucket handle and makes his hair rise. Background: a dry camp yard of packed earth in pale haze, a haystack, horses tethered at stakes. Light: dry pale gold light from the upper left, a thin violet rim light. Expression: a stubborn, wrathful, loyal scowl with the jaw set, a man who will haul water but will not touch a pick.

people.imagined: The camp's counting hut. She is called the Eleventh because she takes one stone in eleven; the spectacles hang on a string and she looks over them. The real ledger is in her sleeve.
people.subject: The moment: at a small table she looks over the top of round spectacles at the viewer, one hand tucked into her opposite sleeve. Face: most important, the spectacles on a string: a pair of round wire spectacles with thick glass lenses hung round her neck on a long cord and pushed down her nose, large in the frame. A narrow, composed, sallow face of about fifty; patient, small, shrewd, black eyes; thin, arched, plucked brows; a long nose; a small, thin, tight mouth; a faint line of powder on the cheek. Hair: black going grey, in a tidy low bun with two iron pins and a small jade comb. Body: small, upright, shoulders neat, sitting very straight. Clothing: the simple graceful silk of a low-realm camp quartermaster, tidy and exact: a dark red-brown layered robe with two crossed high collars and narrow embroidered borders of small coins in dull gold thread, a black gauze over-skirt, a sash with a ring of small keys; one sleeve slightly thicker, with a flat rectangle hidden inside. Hands and objects: the left hand resting on an open bound book with blank ruled pages and a brush; the right hand hidden in the sleeve; a small abacus on the table with eleven red beads set apart on one rod. Power: a faint earth-yellow glimmer lies along the abacus rod. Background: a camp hut with shelves of boxes, a small barred window, soft haze. Light: pale dusty spirit-light from the window at the upper left, a thin line of lamplight on the table, a soft rim on her spectacles. Expression: a patient, mild look over the spectacles with a placid, innocent mouth and sly, careful eyes.

people.imagined: The camp's mess, a corner seat with a view of both doors. He turns a pale band of skin on his finger where a ring once sat; the camp pays better than the plain's merchants.
people.subject: The moment: seated in the corner of a rough hall with his back to the wall, he looks calmly at the viewer, one hand turning something on a finger. Face: most important, the pale band: a clear pale stripe of untanned skin round the base of the left ring finger, where a ring once sat, held up in the foreground against sun-brown skin, the finger bare. A smooth, tanned, even-featured face of about thirty; calm, cautious, grey-brown eyes; straight brows; a straight nose; a closed, businesslike mouth; a faint stubble. Hair: dark brown, cropped short, a pinch of grey at the temple. Body: lean, upright, balanced to leap, seated sideways so that both doors show behind him. Clothing: the graceful silk of a low-realm caravan guard who wears nothing of the camp's colours: a dark grey layered robe with two crossed collars and wide sleeves bound at the wrist with dark cord, a darker over-vest, a plain sash with a short sword at the hip, a small plain jade ring on a cord; wrapped cloth leggings. Hands and objects: the hand with the pale band; a clay cup in the other. Power: a faint earth-yellow and red glow of earth and fire qi lies in the cup's steam. Background: a rough wooden hall in mist with a door at left and a door at right, both open to bright slits of daylight. Light: two bars of pale spirit-light from the doors at left and right, dim in the middle, a soft rim on his cheek. Expression: pragmatic and quietly guarded, as though both doors were already counted and nothing will be said.

people.imagined: The deck of an unlit boat at dawn, just surfaced. Her lips are blue even in summer; her voice is too loud because her ears ring; her people swore never to dive and she does.
people.subject: The moment: hauling herself over a boat's side at dawn, streaming water, she shouts something cheerful at someone off frame. Face: most important, the blue lips: both lips a vivid cold blue-violet against pale skin, wide open in a loud, delighted shout. A small, round, pale, freckled face of about eighteen; bright, brave, grey-blue eyes with red from the salt; thin, straight, dark brows; a short nose; wet lashes. Water runs from her nose and chin. Hair: dark brown, soaking, plastered to her head, a long braid streaming down her back with a thin silver chain through it. Body: small, wiry, strong shoulders, water pouring off her. Clothing: the plain graceful silk of a low-realm pearl diver: a close-clinging short-sleeved sea-green gauze robe with a crossed collar, wet and translucent at the edges, a pale under-wrap, short dark trousers, a braided silk sash with a small bone knife and a net bag at the hip, bare feet. Hands and objects: one hand gripping the gunwale, the other holding up a single large grey-white pearl between finger and thumb; a plain dark unlit lamp hung on the mast behind her. Power: the pearl glows a soft pale grey, and faint blue water-qi motes rise from the dripping water around her. Background: a dark boat with black sails, a pale pink-blue dawn sea in mist, a smudge of land. Light: cold pink-blue dawn spirit-light from the upper left, glitter on the wet, a bright rim light on her shoulders. Expression: a bright, loud, delighted shout, a brave, impatient girl too glad to be heard properly.

people.imagined: A pepper-village loft. A ladder has just broken under her, once a month as always, and she is sitting among spice bundles, laughing at herself with peppery fingers.
people.subject: The moment: sitting on the floor among broken wooden slats and scattered herb bundles, she laughs at herself, a hand lifted to her face. Face: most important, the stained fingers: the fingertips of her right hand stained rust-orange to the second joint with pepper, held up near her cheek, and a streak of orange on her cheek where she has wiped. A soft, round, pink face of about twenty-two with dimples; bright, humble, brown eyes; short eyebrows lifted; a snub nose; a wide, laughing mouth. Hair: light brown, in two thick plaits with some strands loose, a few dried leaves caught in them, a small red pepper charm on a cord. Body: round, small, sitting with legs splayed, surprised. Clothing: the simple graceful silk of a low-realm herb-keeper, clean and soft: a cream silk layered blouse-robe with two crossed collars and wide sleeves rolled above the wrist, a long pale green gauze skirt dusty at the hem, a sash of green silk with a pouch of seeds and a small jade bead; soft cloth shoes. Hands and objects: bunches of dried red peppers and bundles of leaves around her; a broken ladder rung in her left hand. Power: faint green wood-qi motes and a warm red glow float from the peppers. Background: a loft with beams, strings of dried peppers hanging in red curtains, a sunlit window in warm mist. Light: warm golden spirit-light from the upper left through drifting dust, a soft rim on her plaits. Expression: a soft, dimpled, laughing face, bright brown eyes crinkled and lifted brows, entirely without pride.

people.imagined: The red-stone ruin at midday. He has just told a buyer plainly that the carved wall-stone is worth nothing; his cloudy eye wanders as he runs a thumb over the carving.
people.subject: The moment: crouched beside a block of red stone, he runs a thumb along its carved face and looks up at the viewer with a calm shrug. Face: most important, the cloudy eye: the left eye entirely milky blue-white, with no visible pupil, set beside a clear brown right eye, and red dust ground into every crease of the knuckles of the hand on the stone. A long, deeply creased, brown face of about sixty-five with a patient look; thick grey brows; a long nose; a toothless, content mouth; white stubble. Hair: white, thin, tied in a short tail under a flat silk cap coated in red dust. Body: lean, bent, hands large and knotted, crouching easily. Clothing: the simple graceful silk of an old low-realm stone-carver, plain but clean under the dust: a faded brown layered robe with two crossed collars and wide sleeves tied back, coated lightly with red dust, a pale under-robe, a rope-and-silk sash with a small mallet and chisel; wrapped leggings and worn cloth shoes. Hands and objects: the thumb on the carving, a flowing line of fine flame-like grooves with no text; a small stone mallet in the other hand. Power: a faint warm red and earth-yellow glow of fire and earth qi seeps up from the carved grooves. Background: a huge ruin of red stone walls with fallen blocks and weeds, a pale sky of soft cloud. Light: bright pale noon spirit-light from the upper left, the red stone glowing warm, a gentle rim on his white hair. Expression: a patient, toothless, easy smile, one clear brown eye and one milky eye resting calmly on the viewer.

people.imagined: The cinnamon jungle behind the spice port. She smells of cinnamon and whistles through a gap in her teeth as she peels a curl of bark with a knife.
people.subject: The moment: in a green jungle she peels a curl of red-brown bark from a trunk with a small knife, whistling, and glances at the viewer. Face: most important, the whistle and the gap: her lips pursed round a gap between her two front teeth, a whistle visible as a small round O, and a spray of tiny cinnamon flecks on her cheeks. A broad, tanned, cheerful face of about forty; calm, bright, black eyes; thick straight brows; a wide nose. Hair: black with grey at the front, in a thick braid pinned up under a wide straw hat tied with a green silk ribbon. Body: sturdy, broad-shouldered, easy and unhurried. Clothing: the simple graceful silk of a low-realm bark-gatherer: a faded sky-blue layered robe with two crossed collars and wide sleeves rolled to the elbow, a long brown gauze skirt kilted up, a woven bag across her chest filled with rolled bark, a sash of green silk with a small jade bead, leather gloves tucked in; soft sandals. Hands and objects: a short curved bark knife in her right hand with a fresh curl of cinnamon rolling off it; a bundle of rolled quills of cinnamon on her shoulder. Power: green wood-qi motes and a faint warm reddish spice haze drift around her. Background: dense green jungle, broad leaves, hanging vines, thin sunbeams in mist. Light: dappled green-gold spirit-light from the upper left, a soft rim on the hat brim. Expression: a gap-toothed, unhurried smile, calm black eyes and a set chin that will not be hurried or argued with.

people.imagined: High in the jungle canopy, hanging from a vine. Her toes grip the rope like fingers; she grins down at a ground-bound traveller, deciding whether to burn the bundle by her mood.
people.subject: The moment: hanging from a thick vine high in a canopy, one bare foot curled round a rope, she leans out and grins down at the viewer. Face: most important, the gripping feet: both bare feet wrapped round a taut rope, the toes long and spread, curling like fingers around the strands, large in the lower frame. A lean, bright, sunburnt face of about twenty-six with strong cheekbones; sparkling, bold, black eyes; arched brows; a straight nose; a wide, mischievous grin. Hair: black, cut short at the neck and spiky, a red flower tucked behind one ear. Body: wiry, lithe, strong shoulders and long arms, hanging at an angle. Clothing: the plain graceful silk of a young low-realm vine-climber: a short sleeveless leaf-green silk robe with a crossed collar over a thin white gauze under-blouse whose wide sleeves stream behind her, short dark trousers, a sash of vine-green silk with a bone knife, a net bag across her chest full of leaves and orchids, a cord of coloured seeds and a tiny jade bead round her ankle. Hands and objects: one hand clutching the vine overhead; the other holding a bundle of dark green spirit herbs bound with red thread, held out as if offering or about to drop it. Power: a faint green wood-qi glow runs along the vine and a few green motes follow her. Background: a green canopy in mist, huge leaves, hanging orchids, beams of light, the ground far below in haze. Light: bright green-gold spirit-light from the upper left, leaf glitter, a bright rim on her shoulders. Expression: a bold, wild grin with bright eyes, head thrown back, wilful and enjoying her power.

people.imagined: The edge of the miasma plain, afternoon. A herder's boy who walked out grey-haired and calm; he silences the goat bell on his wrist with his thumb when he talks. His face has not aged.
people.subject: The moment: standing at the edge of a grey haze with a bronze door-leaf on his back, he lays his thumb over a small copper bell at his wrist and begins to speak. Face: most important, the white hair and the bell: snow-white hair against a brown unlined face, and a small green-copper goat bell on a cord at his left wrist, his thumb pressed over its mouth. A smooth, brown, ageless face with high cheekbones; clear, calm, very pale-grey eyes with a faint silver sheen; straight dark brows; a straight nose; a quiet, closed mouth. Hair: pure white, cut short and ruffled, as in a child who was frightened once. Body: medium height, lean and quiet, standing balanced. Clothing: the robes of a Kết Đan earth cultivator who dresses without show: a long flowing robe of clay-grey and tan silk, sewn new and perfectly clean, in three layers with crossed collars and wide sleeves, borders embroidered in dull-gold mountain ridges and spirals of dust, a sash of pale grey brocade with a yellow jade disc, a worn leather strap across the chest holding the bronze door on his back, its edge showing, green with age; plain sandals. Hands and objects: the thumb on the bell; in the other hand a long walking staff of grey wood. Power: a slow earth-yellow aura like dust in sunlight pools at his feet and the haze curls grey around him; a faint ring of pale gold lies about the bell. Background: a flat grey plain vanishing into a pale mist, a pale sky, a few fallen stones. Light: pale even spirit-light from the upper left, a cold gleam on the bronze and a soft rim on his white hair. Expression: a still, quiet face, pale silver-grey eyes level and unhurried, the mouth closed on whatever he will say next.

people.imagined: The camp's rampart at sunset. She stands tall and heavy-shouldered with her left forearm bare to show the lightning scars; a clean hooked blade on one hip, a used one on the other.
people.subject: The moment: standing on a stockade rampart at sunset with her left forearm held out, bare, she looks down at the viewer with a bold eye. Face: most important, the lacework forearm: the left forearm a branching net of silver-white, tree-like lightning scars from wrist to elbow, large in the frame, and two hooked blades at her hips, one gleaming clean, the other nicked and dark. A broad, strong, handsome face of about forty-five with a square jaw; hard, bright, amber eyes; thick black brows; a straight, strong nose; a wide, firm mouth with a faint smile; a notch in the left ear. Hair: black with a streak of grey, in a thick braid wound high on the head with an iron pin and a crown-comb of dark silver and red jade. Body: tall, heavy-shouldered, thick-armed and deep-chested, standing wide. Clothing: the robes of a Kết Đan war-leader, rich but martial: a deep crimson layered silk robe with three crossed collars and one sleeve slashed away to bare the scarred forearm, a long black brocade over-robe embroidered with silver lightning and flames, dark lacquered shoulder-plates with arrowheads still stuck in the links, a broad sash with a heavy silver buckle, a lump of fused glassy sand on a cord at the neck. Hands and objects: the bare scarred forearm held out; her right hand on the hilt of the clean hooked blade. Power: violet-white thunder-qi crawls along the scars and crackles in a halo around her, with a warm red glow beneath. Background: a sharpened log stockade, a camp of tents and smoke under a sunset sky. Light: strong orange sunset spirit-light from the left, long shadows, a violet rim along her arm. Expression: a bold amber stare and a faint hard smile, chin lifted, the look of a woman who takes what she wants and gives the orders.

people.imagined: The free crossing at noon. A stern lamp burns on the boat in daylight; he has not let it go out since 1174. The pole has grooved his palms.
people.subject: The moment: standing at the stern of a flat ferry at noon, he holds out both palms toward the viewer as if showing his hands, a lit lamp burning behind him. Face: most important, the daylight lamp: a small fisher's stern lamp of brass and glass hung on a post behind his shoulder, its flame bright and small in full sun, large at the upper right. A narrow, long, brown face of about fifty-five, lined like dried leather; patient, tired, dark eyes; thin grey brows; a long, thin nose; a small, honest mouth; a thin grey goatee. Hair: grey, tied in a knot under a split straw hat with a hole in its crown. Body: thin and narrow-shouldered, upright, long arms, standing steady with his feet apart. Clothing: the robes of a Trúc Cơ river cultivator, graceful and weathered: a long deep-teal layered silk robe with two crossed collars and wide sleeves rolled to the elbow, borders embroidered in dull silver waves, a blue silk cloth round his neck, trousers rolled to the knee, bare feet, a braided silk sash with a small stone hung on a cord. Hands and objects: both palms turned up, each crossed by a deep pale groove worn by the pole; a long bamboo pole leaning against the rail. Power: faint blue-green water-qi ripples slowly around his feet, and the lamp flame glows gold. Background: a wide river in mist, flat ferry deck, a stone anchor on a rope, distant banks. Light: bright high pale noon spirit-light from the upper left, the small lamp flame glowing yellow in the sun, a soft rim on his hat. Expression: a steady, honest gaze from patient eyes with a cautious crease at the brow, the mouth quiet as he shows his palms.

people.imagined: The Night Rain Market at the lane's dark end. He sells maps; his eyes do not narrow in the dark, and a rolled map sits behind each ear. He smiles softly at a buyer.
people.subject: The moment: seated at a stall in a dim lane, he smiles gently at the viewer and spreads a map on the table with ink-black fingers. Face: most important, the rolled maps and the ink: a rolled paper tube tucked behind each ear like pens, and ink-black fingertips to the second knuckle on both hands. A soft, long, pale face of about forty-five with a gentle expression; large, calm, dark eyes wide open in the dark with enormous pupils; thin brows; a long nose; a small soft smile; a thin moustache. Hair: black, combed back, tied in a small knot with a pale jade pin. Body: slender, soft shouldered, seated with a slight lean forward. Clothing: the robes of a Trúc Cơ map-seller, scholarly and slightly rumpled: a long dark indigo layered silk robe with three crossed collars, wide sleeves with ink spots, many pale paper pages sewn into the lining and showing at the open front, borders embroidered in fine silver contour lines and tiny mushroom marks, a pale blue silk sash, a pear-wood stamp on a cord at the neck. Hands and objects: the right hand smoothing the map, a pale sheet with faint cave lines and mushroom signs but no writing; the left holds a small brush. Power: faint green wood-qi motes drift off the map like spores. Background: a rain-dark market lane in mist, a few red paper lanterns, wet cobbles. Light: dim red lantern glow at the lower right, cool silver-blue moonlight from the upper left, a soft rim on his hair. Expression: soft, deceitful, friendly.

people.imagined: A rainy day at the fortune-teller's mat. She tilts her head before answering as if the wind told her first; she has never been wrong about the weather, and she smiles.
people.subject: The moment: seated cross-legged on a mat under a small awning, she tilts her head to one side as if listening, then smiles broadly. Face: most important, the tilted head and smile: her whole head cocked toward her left shoulder at a clear angle, eyes bright and a round-cheeked smile. A round, rosy, plump face of about fifty with dimples; bright, merry, dark-brown eyes; thin curved brows; a small nose; a wide, sweet mouth; fine laugh lines fanning from the eyes. Hair: black with grey, in a thick bun with a white wind-bell charm hanging from a silver pin by her ear. Body: round, soft and comfortable, sitting at ease, shoulders loose. Clothing: the robes of a Trúc Cơ wind-diviner, soft and layered: a long robe of dull gold and brown silk with three crossed collars and wide, floating sleeves, the hem stitched with a band of faded red thread and borders embroidered in pale silver spirals of wind, a wide sash of faded blue brocade, a necklace of small bells, jade and wooden beads, a thick shawl of grey gauze. Hands and objects: a small paper pinwheel held lightly between two fingers, its vanes turning; a bowl of dried beans on her knee; a small wooden rain-token and three red beans on the mat before her. Power: a faint pale-silver wind-qi lifts the charm, her sleeve and the pinwheel in a soft swirl. Background: a small awning of oiled paper in the rain, mist, a faint market behind. Light: soft silver-grey rainy spirit-light from the upper left, a pearly rim on her cheek. Expression: a cheerful, kind, slyly deceitful smile with bright eyes, the head cocked as if the wind had spoken first.

people.imagined: A market wall at night. He stands with his back to it, as he has since the pass of Đan Sơn Mạch, a sword with the Dipper filed off its guard at his side.
people.subject: The moment: standing with his back to a stone wall in a night market, he rests a hand on a sword hilt and watches the crowd beyond the viewer. Face: most important, the filed guard: a sword guard of dark steel with a smooth, shiny, freshly filed patch in the shape where seven small stars once were, plainly visible at the hilt, held large in the frame. A long, lean, weathered face of about forty-eight; grey at the temples; level, grey, patient eyes; thick straight brows; a straight nose; a firm, closed mouth; a short grey beard. Hair: black and grey, tied back with a plain silk cord and a dark steel hairpin. Body: broad-shouldered, upright, planted with his shoulders flat to the wall and a leg slightly forward. Clothing: the robes of a Trúc Cơ sword-cultivator in exile, severe and fine: a dark charcoal layered silk robe with three crossed high collars and wide sleeves, a plain steel-grey over-robe, borders embroidered in pale silver thread of crossed blades, a faded steppe scarf of dull red silk, a plain sash with a worn bronze token. Hands and objects: the right hand resting on the sword hilt; the left hand relaxed at his side. Power: a faint grey-gold aura of metal qi clings thin around the blade, a cold hush at his shoulder. Background: a lantern-lit night market in mist, stalls and moving figures, dark. Light: warm lantern glow from the lower left, cold silver-blue moonlight from the upper left on the wall, a bright rim on his jaw. Expression: a level, reserved stare over the crowd, the jaw set stubborn and the mouth closed, fair-minded and unmoved.

people.imagined: A potter's yard at dusk. Clay under one thumbnail; she throws bronze snare coins strung on hunting wire to keep a Thunder-rooted daughter safe. She suspects everyone.
people.subject: The moment: in a potter's yard she holds a strand of bronze coins on hunting wire, and looks over her shoulder at the viewer with suspicion. Face: most important, the coin wire and the clay: a loop of thin hunting wire strung with a dozen round bronze discs held in her right hand ready to throw, and a crescent of grey clay under the thumbnail. A strong, square, tanned face of about forty-two with high cheeks; wary, dark brown eyes; thick straight brows; a short nose; a mouth set tight. Hair: black, tied back in a thick plait, a smear of clay at the temple, a headscarf of faded blue silk pulled down. Body: sturdy, thick-wristed, standing half-turned, one foot behind. Clothing: the robes of a Trúc Cơ potter-huntress, practical but graceful: a long brown silk layered robe with three crossed collars and wide sleeves rolled and tied back, a long pale gauze over-robe with a lacquered apron panel stained with grey clay, borders embroidered in dull bronze thread of coin rings, a sash with a hunter's knife and a small jade bead; soft felt boots. Hands and objects: the wire of coins in the right hand; a small ball of wet clay in the left. Power: a faint grey-gold sheen of metal qi on the coins and a thin violet thread of thunder qi between them. Background: a yard with a round kiln and shelves of unglazed pots, a darkening sky, smoke. Light: orange kiln glow from the right, silver-grey spirit-light from the upper left, a warm rim on her cheek. Expression: paranoid, protective, shrewd.

people.imagined: A hill road a day before a storm. Her hair lifts a little off her shoulders as it always does when thunder is coming; she grips a copy of the Thousand-Bolt Scripture her father bought.
people.subject: The moment: standing on a ridge with her face turned to a darkening sky, her hair lifting off her shoulders. Face: most important, the lifting hair: long black hair visibly rising and floating outward from her head in strands, as in static, in a clear fan. A quick, sunburnt, bright face of about seventeen with strong cheekbones; sharp, brave, dark eyes; arched brows; a short nose; a determined mouth just starting to smile. The wind has reddened her ears and chin. Hair: black and long, worn loose with a single red thread tied at the nape. Body: lean, wiry, quick, shoulders squared, leaning into the wind. Clothing: the plain graceful silk of a young low-realm storm-seeker: a short brown layered silk robe with a red cord at the collar and two crossed collars, wide sleeves whipping in the wind, a thin white gauze under-robe, short trousers with wrapped legs, a sash with a small hunting knife and a thin silver ring. Hands and objects: a thin paper book with a blank cover gripped in one fist, its page corners soft with handling, her knuckles white; the other hand held out open, palm up, fingers spread to feel the storm. Power: tiny sparks of violet-white thunder qi dance on her fingertips and a faint violet glow lifts through her hair. Background: heavy purple-black clouds piling above a green ridge, a distant bright slit on the horizon. Light: dramatic cold spirit-light from the upper left against dark cloud, a thin white glint on her cheek and a violet rim on her hair. Expression: a brave, eager, half-smiling impatience with bright eyes on the storm.

people.imagined: A ridge trail in the cave hunters' country. A grey hound that never barks sits at his side; two fingers are gone from his left hand and his split-gourd face makes the children stare.
people.subject: The moment: crouched beside a grey hound on a ridge trail, he lays his left hand on its neck and looks up at the viewer with slow patience. Face: most important, the face and the hand: a broad face deformed like a split gourd, with a deep old scar splitting the forehead down through the brow, nose and cheek so the two sides of the face do not quite meet, and the left hand with only a thumb and two fingers. Heavy, slow, brown eyes of a man of about fifty-five, one lid dragged lower; a flattened nose; a wide, patient mouth; a thick black and grey beard. Hair: black and grey, long and tied back with a silk band and a plain bone pin. Body: broad, big, slow and solid, crouching with great calm. Clothing: the robes of a Trúc Cơ mountain hunter, simple but clean: a long tan layered silk robe with two crossed collars and wide sleeves bound at the wrist, a wolf-fur trimmed collar, borders embroidered in dull grey-gold spear-leaf patterns, a brown gauze over-robe, a broad sash with a heavy hunter's knife and a small jade charm; wrapped leggings. Hands and objects: the three-fingered hand on the hound's neck; a long spear with a broad leaf blade in the right hand, butt on the ground; the grey ridge hound with a scarred muzzle sitting still. Power: a faint grey-gold aura of metal qi traces the spear blade and the hound's eyes. Background: a rocky ridge with scrub in mist, cave mouths in the cliff, pale sky. Light: cool silver-grey spirit-light from the upper left, a soft rim on his beard. Expression: a slow, steady, patient look from the split-gourd face, calm eyes unflinching and the mouth easy.

people.imagined: The deck of an unlit boat at night. A coat dyed black with mangrove bark makes her a shadow; she sails dark as her ancestors did, and her lips are cracked.
people.subject: The moment: standing at a ship's rail at night in a black coat, she squints out at the sea, the dark sail behind her. Face: most important, the black coat and the squint: a long coat dyed a deep matt black, nearly invisible against the night so only her face and hands show, and her eyes narrowed in a sailor's squint. A weathered, brown, sharp face of about forty-five with salt-cracked lips; narrow, hard, dark eyes; thin straight brows; a long nose; a thin hard mouth; fine wind-lines. Hair: black with grey, cropped short and salt-stiff, a single dark silver pin. Body: tall, lean, standing with legs apart and braced to the sea. Clothing: the robes of a Trúc Cơ sea-captain, severe and rich in black: a long mangrove-black silk over-robe with a high collar over a layered dark teal silk under-robe with three crossed collars, wide sleeves, borders embroidered in matt black on black with faint wave and star-chart patterns, a rope-and-silk sash with a small knife and a brass compass; no lights. Hands and objects: one hand gripping a rope shroud; the other holding a rolled black sail cloth; behind her a square sail dyed black and stitched in an odd pattern. Power: a faint blue water-qi sheen runs along the wet rail and her sleeves. Background: a night sea in mist with faint white wave crests, no lamps, a pale low moon. Light: faint cold moonlight from the upper left on her face and hands only, a thin silver rim on the black coat. Expression: a hard squint out at the dark sea with cracked lips pressed flat and a cold, ambitious set to the jaw.

people.imagined: The empty quays of Bích Không Cảng at low tide. His father sailed on the first lost boat when he was eight. He wears the bronze sail-ring on his thumb and looks over the empty harbour.
people.subject: The moment: sitting on the edge of an empty stone quay with his legs over the water, he looks out at the empty harbour. Face: most important, the thumb ring and the scarred ears: a heavy bronze sail-ring on his right thumb, shiny and dented, and both ears scarred and puckered at their rims from deep pressure. A long, hollow-cheeked, brown face of about thirty-five; deep-set, tired, grey-green eyes; thick brows; a long nose; a patient, set mouth; dark stubble. Salt has dried to a faint white line along his cheekbone and jaw. Hair: black, long, wet, tied back with a pale silk cord. Body: long-limbed with a hollow, narrow chest from diving, shoulders narrow and bony. Clothing: the robes of a Trúc Cơ diver, faded but graceful: an open layered robe of faded sea-blue silk with two crossed collars and wide sleeves rolled to the elbow, borders embroidered in pale silver waves worn to thread, short trousers, a sash with a diving knife and a net bag; bare feet. Hands and objects: the right hand with the bronze ring resting on his knee; the left holding a coil of rope with a stone weight. Power: faint blue water-qi motes rise from the still water under his feet. Background: an empty harbour with grey water in mist, tall bare mooring posts, a line of empty stone quays, weed-furred ladders descending the quay walls, low-tide mud shining in the pale light, a pale low horizon. Light: pale cool pearl-grey spirit-light from the upper left, a thin silver rim on his hair. Expression: a still, stubborn, reclusive patience, the tired grey-green eyes on the empty water.

people.imagined: A ridge market in morning. A bird sings and he stops mid-word, flute in his hand, head tilted toward it. In 1195 every bird fell silent for his tune.
people.subject: The moment: standing in a market with a bamboo flute in his hand, he stops mid-word, head tilted up toward a bird's song, mouth still half-open. Face: most important, the flute and the tilt: a slender dark bamboo flute with six finger-stops in his hand, and his head cocked upward with a listening, rapt look. A thin, gentle, pale face of about thirty-four with a long nose; soft, wide, brown eyes; thin straight brows; a half-open mouth; calluses on his lip and fingers; long lashes that curl at the ends. Hair: black, loose to the shoulders and unkempt, held by a wooden pin and a thin pale ribbon. Body: thin, light, slightly stooped, standing with his weight on one leg. Clothing: the plain graceful silk of a low-realm flute-maker, clean and soft at the cuffs: a flowing grey-blue layered robe with two crossed collars and wide sleeves, borders embroidered in faint pale-gold sound-rings, a long pale gauze scarf, a silk sash with a string of small clay whistles at the neck and a small jade pendant; cloth shoes. Hands and objects: the flute held loosely in the right hand; the left hand raised a little with a finger up, as if to ask for silence. Power: a faint pale-gold metal-qi ring shimmers in the air like a sound wave around the flute. Background: a bright morning market with stalls in mist, a small brown bird on a roof beam, awnings of red and yellow cloth and a basket of pale melons making soft blurs on either side. Light: soft clear morning spirit-light from the upper left, a gentle rim on his hair. Expression: a trusting, humble, rapt listening with the head tilted and the mouth half-open on an unspoken word.

people.imagined: 940, the stockade gate. A memorial portrait of the old rogue chief who died at the gate so his people could reach the wall; he holds a hooked blade and a hand up to say go.
people.subject: The moment: a memorial portrait, faded and yellowed like an old silk painting, edges darkened; a huge old man stands in a gateway, one hand raised palm outward and the other holding a hooked blade. Face: most important, the raised hand and the hooked blade: his right hand held high with the palm out, a broad scarred hand, and a heavy hooked blade in his left hand, large and clear. A broad, craggy, dark face of about fifty-five, scarred on the cheek; fierce, generous, dark eyes; thick black brows streaked with white; a big nose; a broad mouth shouting; a thick grey-black beard. Hair: black and grey, long, in a topknot with a dark silver crown-pin. Body: huge, massive-chested and heavy-armed, standing wide. Clothing: the robes of a fallen war-leader, rich and martial: a dark red-brown layered silk robe with three crossed collars and wide sleeves, a dark mail-patterned brocade over-robe embroidered in silver lightning and flame, a wolf-fur cloak thrown over one shoulder, a broad sash with an iron-silver buckle. Hands and objects: the raised hand; the hooked blade, its tip down. Power: a faint violet-white thunder-qi and grey-gold metal-qi aura, softened by the fade. Background: a pale, mottled, aged-silk ground, with the faint outline of a stockade gate and stakes. Light: soft light from the upper left, dark vignette. Expression: a fierce, open-mouthed shout with generous, burning eyes, a leader calling his people to follow.

people.imagined: 1195, the autumn before the tigers. A memorial portrait of the hunter who bought his daughter a Thunder method; he holds a small rolled paper and smiles.
people.subject: The moment: a memorial portrait, faded and yellowed like an old silk painting, edges darkened; a broad, kind hunter stands with a rolled scroll in his hand, smiling. Face: most important, the scroll and the smile: a rolled paper tied with cord held up in his right hand like a gift, and a broad, warm smile with a missing tooth. A square, ruddy, weathered face of about fifty; warm, bright, brown eyes; thick brown brows; a short nose; a wide mouth; a short brown beard; weather-reddened cheeks, the missing tooth making his smile a little lopsided. Hair: brown and grey, tied in a short tail with a silk strip, under a fur cap with earflaps. Body: stocky, broad-shouldered, standing relaxed. Clothing: the plain graceful silk of a low-realm hunter, clean and festive for the gift: a brown layered silk robe with two crossed collars and wide sleeves bound at the wrist, a tiger-striped fur collar, borders embroidered in dull gold, a sash with snare discs strung on wire and a hunter's knife; wrapped boots. Hands and objects: the scroll in the right hand; the left hand on a spear shaft. Power: a faint violet-white thunder-qi shimmer, softened by the fade. Background: a pale, mottled, aged-silk ground with a faint outline of ridge hills. Light: soft light from the upper left, dark vignette; the silk fade turns the brown robe to a dull gold and the sky to cream and ash. Expression: a warm, broad, gap-toothed gladness, the kind brown eyes crinkled, a father who has just bought his daughter a gift.

people.imagined: 1158, the first deep-water boat. A memorial portrait of the fisher who signed on for the wage and the story, standing at a mast with a bright grin and a coiled rope.
people.subject: The moment: a memorial portrait, faded and yellowed like an old silk painting, edges darkened; a young fisher grins at the mast of a boat with a coil of rope on his arm. Face: most important, the bright grin and the sail: a broad open grin, and behind him a square sail with its edge visible. A lean, tanned, cheerful face of about thirty-eight with bright, merry, dark eyes; arched brows; a straight nose; a gap-toothed grin; a small gold hoop in one ear. Hair: black, long and tied back with a blue silk cord. Body: lean, rangy, easy, leaning on the mast; wide shoulders for his lean frame, chest brown and open to the wind, stance loose with one knee bent, carefree. Clothing: the plain graceful silk of a low-realm fisher: a sleeveless pale blue silk over-robe with a crossed collar worn open over a thin gauze under-robe with wide sleeves, short grey trousers, a woven sash with a leather pouch of coins; barefoot. Hands and objects: the coil of rope on the left arm, in neat loops; the right hand waving; a faded red thread tied round his wrist and a small bronze fish-hook on a cord at his neck. Power: a faint blue water-qi shimmer, softened by the fade. Background: a pale, mottled, aged-silk ground with the faint outline of a mast and a pale sea. Light: soft light from the upper left, dark vignette; a thin pale yellow gleam picks out the mast and the edge of the sail as old gold. Expression: a broad, gap-toothed, easy grin, merry eyes and one hand waving, restless and glad to be seen.
